use_case: A terminal coding assistant powered by Gemini: you ask it in plain language to understand, edit, debug and test code in a local repo, and it reads and writes files, runs shell commands and git, and looks things up on the web. It can also run headless in scripts or GitHub Actions.
not_for: no built-in GUI or desktop control
no dedicated database/SQL tooling beyond the shell or MCP servers
only uses Gemini models (Google auth, Gemini API key or Vertex AI)
evidence: README.md lines 17-28 and 108-144 describe a terminal-first agent with file-operation, shell, Google Search and web-fetch tools, plus MCP support, non-interactive scripting and GitHub Action integration. packages/core/src/tools/ contains the tools (edit, write-file, read-file, glob, grep/ripGrep, shell, web-search, web-fetch, write-todos, MCP and memory tools). packages/core/src/prompts/snippets.ts:192-193 sets the system prompt to "an interactive CLI agent specializing in software engineering tasks"; lines 260 and 367 tell it to add and run tests, lint and type-check (e.g. 'tsc', 'ruff check .'), and lines 506-519 give git commit steps. packages/core/src/agents/ has subagents (codebase-investigator, generalist) and remote A2A agents.
